summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K announcing a 5% increase in the exchange ratio for its voluntary exchange offer to acquire the roughly 10% of Santander Brasil common shares, preferred shares, units and ADSs it does not already own, via concurrent Brazilian and US offers. Holders now receive 0.4260 new Santander shares per unit or ADS (from 0.4056) and 0.2130 per common or preferred share (from 0.2028), before dividend adjustments. Full acceptance implies about 166 million new shares, roughly 1.1% of capital, and a maximum consideration of about €1.9 billion at the prior close. Santander shareholder approval of capital increases is sought at an extraordinary meeting expected 15 December 2026; customary regulatory approvals and no-MAC conditions apply, with consideration in BDRs or ADSs.
